verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party docs say Terminal ships official SDKs for iOS and Android, plus React Native. The docs also show the SDK accepting contactless payments on compatible iPhones and Android devices, a built-in simulated reader for development, and a versioned SDK (5.0.0 migration guide). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the native mobile SDKs work well when embedded in third-party apps, since the community comments speak only generally about API-level terminal integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs

citations.quote: Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
Accept contactless payments using a compatible iPhone or Android device with the Stripe Terminal SDK.
Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Learn how to migrate to version 5.0.0 of the Stripe Terminal SDK.
